'''Madillis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] businesswoman who was the partner of [[Jondris]]. Jondris kept images of Madillis stored in his [[Time Piece Model 7643]] [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]] to help him when he missed her during her business trips.<ref name="GFT" />
